pkgmetadata.longdescription: Kimi Code Desktop is the graphical client of the Kimi Code agent from Moonshot AI. It runs the agent in a window with plans, sessions, a built-in terminal and editor integrations, and signs in to the Kimi Code service or a user-supplied model provider.

use.flag: Let the Electron window use the native Wayland backend when the session is Wayland.
